verses.html: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.text: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

verses.html: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.text: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

verses.html: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.text: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

verses.html: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
verses.text: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

verses.html: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
verses.text: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

verses.html: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
verses.text: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

verses.html: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
verses.text: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

verses.html: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
verses.text: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

verses.html: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
verses.text: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

verses.html: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.text: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

verses.html: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
verses.text: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.

verses.html: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
verses.text: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:

verses.html: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
verses.text: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

verses.html: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.text: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.

verses.html: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
verses.text: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.

verses.html: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
verses.text: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)

verses.html: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.text: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

verses.html: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
verses.text: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

verses.html: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
verses.text: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

verses.html: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
verses.text: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

verses.html: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
verses.text: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

verses.html: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
verses.text: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
